+"""Record preparation steps built on pytest async-function detection."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.compat import is_async_function
+
+
+def display_async(value: object) -> bool:
+    """Return True if value is a coroutine function or async generator function."""
+    return bool(callable(value) and is_async_function(value))
+
+
+def prepare(
+    record: object, display: Callable[[Any], Any] = display_async
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate record and return a new prepared dict.
+
+    The result has exactly key (trimmed), value (unchanged), display
+    (display applied to value) and enabled. The input is never mutated.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value entry")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {
+        "key": key.strip(),
+        "value": value,
+        "display": display(value),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }

@@ -38,3 +38,19 @@ def prepare(
         "display": display(value),
         "enabled": enabled,
     }
+
+
+def batch(records: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare each record in order, rejecting duplicate trimmed keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {key!r}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

@@ -54,3 +54,12 @@ def batch(records: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
         seen.add(key)
         prepared.append(item)
     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records: object) -> dict[str, list[Any]]:
+    """Group display values of enabled records by first key character."""
+    groups: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return groups

+    """Merge prepared records; right replaces left by key, new keys append."""
